title: Heat Pump FSM — RUNNING and ERROR States Unhandled
bug_signature: UVM_FATAL: [DEADLOCK] Heat pump FSM trapped in RUNNING; stop signal ignored
testbench: initial begin reset = 1; #10 reset = 0; start = 1; end
expected_root_cause: The case statement has branches only for IDLE and STARTUP; the RUNNING and ERROR states have no matching branches, so next is undriven when the FSM reaches either of those states and the controller freezes.
description: The heat pump controller FSM handles IDLE and STARTUP in the next-state logic but has no branches for RUNNING or ERROR; once in RUNNING the FSM never transitions out, and ERROR is a permanent trap.
failure_log: UVM_FATAL: [DEADLOCK] Heat pump FSM trapped in RUNNING; stop signal ignored
success_log: FSM exits RUNNING on stop or fault. ERROR returns to IDLE in one cycle.
